title: Pikmin Bloom Walking Adventure
notes:
Thanks for playing Pikmin Bloom! New in this version:

- Added Simplified Chinese to the language settings. Switch to it from Settings > Accessibility > Language. 
- "Use System Settings" is not supported yet, but will be in a future update.
- Tap a mission under "Next steps to level up" in your profile to go to the screen where you can make progress.
- Minor improvements and bug fixes.

*Please download the latest version of the app from the store for the changes above to be reflected.

title: Blaze of Battle
notes:
Update!

About Troop Promotion Cost: Troop Promotion costs may be higher in older versions and lower in the new version.

About Treasures: The Skyboat's land area will expand, while the number of Treasure Castles remains unchanged.

About Knight Spells: Knight Spells can only be cast on players within the same War Zone. Attempting to cast Knight Spells on players outside your War Zone will trigger a pop-up prompt.
